title: Summator C++ example fails to compile
body:
### Tested versions

### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7-stable, master
- Not reproducible in 4.6.2-stable, 4.6.3-stable

## Minimal reproduction project (MRP)
https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/engine_details/engine_api/custom_modules_in_cpp.html

## System information
Windows 11, build with VS Community 2022 compiler
